resources.string: Screen time. Stability looks at when your screen turns on and off. For each of the last 28 days it adds up how long the screen was on. It also counts the minutes between midnight and 5 a.m., and notes the first and last time you used your phone. It adds up time in games. An app counts as a game only if the app itself tells Android it is one. It does not save which apps you used.

Health Connect, if you connect it. Stability reads the sleep and steps your phone or watch recorded. It keeps how long you slept each night and when you went to bed. It also keeps your steps each day.

The Stability keyboard, if you turn it on. It reads what you type as you type it and never saves the words. When a message ends, it counts your typing speed and pauses. It counts how often you went back to fix something, and whether the message read as low mood. Then the words are dropped.

If a message sounds like you might hurt yourself, the keyboard opens a screen with 988. This includes words you typed and then deleted before sending. It may ask if you are safe right now. It saves the time and your answer, never the words.
This app has no internet permission, so it cannot send anything. The numbers leave your phone only if you save the file and share it yourself.
Stability is linked to a parent. A note to them can say which areas changed, like sleep, and for how long. It never includes these numbers or your words.
Android asks you to allow this yourself. Tap the button, find Stability in the list, and turn on usage access. You can turn it off again in the same place at any time.
This phone has no usage access screen to open. Look in Settings under Apps, then Special app access.
Health Connect is not available on this phone. It needs Android 9 or later.
Health Connect is not installed, or it needs an update.
This phone has no Play Store to get it from.
Not connected. Connecting lets Stability read sleep sessions and steps. You can connect it later.
Health Connect did not give access. You can allow it in Health Connect.
Connected. Stability reads sleep and steps while this screen is open.
Could not read Health Connect this time. Tap Refresh to try again.
Stability reads two kinds of records from Health Connect: sleep sessions and steps. It reads the last 28 days, and only while you have the Stability screen open.
For each night it works out how long you slept and when you went to bed. For each day it adds up your steps. It does not keep the records themselves.
Nothing leaves your phone. The app has no internet permission. The numbers go into a file only if you save one, and only you can share that file.
You can stop this at any time with Disconnect in the Stability app, or in Health Connect\'s own settings.
The Stability keyboard is off. Turn it on in Settings, then choose it as your keyboard.
The Stability keyboard is on, but another keyboard is in use.
The Stability keyboard is in use.
It types in every field. It does not count or check anything in password fields, incognito tabs, or email, web address and number fields.
This phone has no keyboard settings screen to open.
While the Stability keyboard is on, Stability shows a notification, so you always know it is checking what you type. Android asks you to allow notifications first.
Shows while the Stability keyboard is on.
It checks what you type on this phone and keeps daily counts, never your words. Tap to see them.
Thank you for answering. You can still call or text 988 at any time.
If you have hurt yourself or taken something, call 911 now.
You can call or text 988 any time, day or night. It is free, and someone will listen.
You can also talk to someone you trust. Stability did not save what you typed.
This phone has no app for that. Call 988 or 911 from another phone.
Android gave no screen times. Unlock your phone, then tap Refresh.
No full days yet. Check again tomorrow.
Android keeps a few days of screen history. Open this app at least once a week so older days are kept here.
This phone did not log the screen turning on and off, which is normal on Android 8. Time is counted while an app is open on screen.
